reason: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year, so paying ₹12,990 upfront for a two-person practice feels unjustified, especially after we abandoned previous software within two months. I will not commit paid funds when there is a free pilot to see if my staff actually sticks with it first.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra twice as expensive, and will my assistant just abandon it after two months like our past software?
would_change_my_mind: Positive feedback from colleagues at my monthly ICAI study circle and proof during the free pilot that my assistant actively uses it past two months without friction.
